redesign_basis: A detector event becomes available to the gait FSM only after the 30 ms debounce has been confirmed. Therefore confirmed_time_s, rather than the raw threshold-crossing onset, is the physically observable detector timestamp and is the only timestamp allowed to drive selection or PASS/FAIL. This semantic correction was frozen before opening the 50-100 s validation block; the 100-155.045 s sealed block remains closed.
objective: Select a low-force heel/toe detector threshold on the development block using confirmed detector events, lock one candidate, and validate exactly that candidate plus the unchanged 5/2 N comparator on 50-100 s. Detector onset is retained only as a diagnostic of threshold crossing and cannot affect ranking, eligibility, promotion or failure. No policy is trained or evaluated and runtime configuration is not modified.

replay.time_span: full intersection of prescribed IK and prescribed GRF

event_time_contract.primary_reference_timestamp: prescribed left vertical-GRF event time at 20 N
event_time_contract.primary_matching: precision, recall, ordered all-event error, max-absolute error, event order, cycle count and phase-transition timing all use confirmed_time_s
required_onset_diagnostics: ordered onset errors for heel strike and toe off
onset bias, MAE and maximum absolute error
event_time_contract.confirmation_latency_gate: Every accepted gait event must satisfy sensor_dwell_s <= confirmed_time_s - event_time_s <= sensor_dwell_s + sample_dt_s, up to numerical epsilon.
event_time_contract.phase_mismatch_window: Fixed around the prescribed reference event using the corresponding confirmed-time tolerance plus at most one sample for discretization; do not add sensor_dwell_s again because dwell is already included in confirmed_time_s.
event_time_contract.fail_closed_rule: Missing, duplicated, unmatched or out-of-order confirmed events fail even when onset diagnostics look correct.

phase_reference_contract.source: the same prescribed left-GRF HS and TO events used by the timing gate
phase_reference_contract.construction: stance from each accepted reference HS to the following accepted reference TO; swing from that TO to the following accepted reference HS
phase_reference_contract.short_grf_recrossings: crossings rejected by the frozen event extractor do not create isolated phase labels
phase_reference_contract.causality_note: event timestamps remain the physical prescribed-GRF onsets accepted after the frozen minimum-duration check; no future detector or holdout result is used
phase_reference_contract.reason: V2 exposed a contradiction in which two short GRF recrossings rejected as HS events were nevertheless counted as instantaneous stance samples. V3 removes that contradiction before opening validation; it does not add a post-hoc detector tolerance.

candidate_grid.generation: Cartesian low-force grid in listed order plus the unchanged external 5/2 N comparator; every low-force OFF is below every low-force ON

chronological_split.unit: complete prescribed left HS-to-HS cycle fully contained in each preregistered time block
chronological_split.development: rerun all complete cycles with HS start >= 11.99 s and next HS <= 50.0 s under the V3 confirmed-time contract; select and hash-lock exactly one candidate
chronological_split.validation: only after the V3 development lock, evaluate the selected candidate and unchanged 5/2 N comparator on complete cycles with HS start >= 50.0 s and next HS <= 100.0 s
chronological_split.sealed: complete cycles with HS start >= 100.0 s and next HS <= 155.045 s remain closed and unread during development and validation
chronological_split.validation_candidates: V3 development-selected winner and baseline only
chronological_split.sealed_candidates: V3 development-selected winner and baseline only
chronological_split.sealed_open_policy: Do not open as part of V3 development or middle-block validation. A later explicit authorization may open it once, only after validation PASS, without retuning or replacing the locked candidate.

stable_plateau.purpose: reject an isolated confirmed-time optimum before ranking

sealed_validation_gate.applies_to: 50-100 s validation and, only if separately authorized later, the still-sealed 100-155.045 s block

contact_diagnostics_not_gates.stable_sensor_union: stable heel latch OR stable toe latch
contact_diagnostics_not_gates.legacy_compatible_aggregate: 100 ms causal moving average of aggregate virtual heel+toe normal load > 15 N
contact_diagnostics_not_gates.warning: The stable sensor union and legacy-compatible aggregate are distinct signals and must never be reported as the same metric. Neither may replace confirmed FSM phase or confirmed event timing in a gate.

interpretation_limits: V3 changes validation semantics: confirmed_time_s is the observable detector output consumed by the FSM; detector onset remains required for debounce, FSM bookkeeping and latency auditing, but its error against the GRF reference has no timing PASS/FAIL or ranking authority.
The phase reference is event-consistent: short prescribed-GRF recrossings rejected by the frozen 50 ms event extractor cannot independently label stance samples.
V3 must rerun development because V2 rankings based on onset timing cannot be reused under the confirmed-time contract.
The 50-100 s validation block must not be opened before the V3 development candidate and manifest hashes are frozen; the 100-155.045 s sealed block remains closed during this protocol execution.
Low simulated force thresholds require later hardware/noise validation and are not a final physical sensor specification.
The chronological holdout remains AB06 treadmill_01_01; passing does not establish cross-subject or cross-task generalization.
Threshold promotion changes neither the checked-in training configuration nor the runtime detector; promotion requires a separate explicit decision after this report.
